sample_unit: daily diet plans (3 days x 6 LLMs)
models_evaluated: six widely used LLMs (names not given in abstract)

links.outcome: LLM meal plan guideline adherence and nutrient deviation versus dietitian reference diet
links.effect: Most LLM diets deviated from reference, with lower energy, carbohydrate and fiber; guideline adherence scores varied substantially across models, with only one model relatively consistent.
links.quote: Guideline adherence scores varied substantially across models, with only one model showing relatively consistent performance.

links.outcome: Quantitative accuracy of LLM-generated energy and macronutrient content against reference
links.effect: Bland-Altman analyses showed significant bias and wide limits of agreement for key nutrients, indicating clinically meaningful discrepancies.
links.quote: Bland-Altman analyses demonstrated significant bias and wide limits of agreement for key nutrients, indicating clinically meaningful discrepancies.

screen.reason: Evaluates six LLMs on diabetes meal planning tasks compared to standard dietitian guidelines and nutritional targets using professional nutrition software and dietitian scoring, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or intervention.
